name: ProjectDetailt selector not updating on chat selection
description:
# Summary

1. **Issue Identified**: The `ProjectDetailt` selector in ChatView.vue wasn't updating when switching between parent and child chats, causing it to display the wrong project context.

2. **Root Cause**: The `targetProject` variable was only set during initialization and didn't react to changes in the `workingChat` computed property when selecting child chats.

3. **Solution Implemented**: Added a watcher on `workingChat` that automatically updates both `targetProject` and `subtaskProject` whenever the working chat changes.

4. **Watcher Behavior**: The new watcher triggers whenever a child chat is selected, parent is navigated to, or the active chat switches, keeping the project selector synchronized.

5. **Result**: Users now see the correct project context in the ProjectDetailt selector regardless of whether they're viewing the parent chat or any of its child chats.

messages.content: When a chat has many crumb elements boards, parent name.... becomes too large, force a max text length with truncate ellipisis

I'll help you fix the header breadcrumbs to prevent them from becoming too large by adding proper truncation with ellipsis. Looking at the code, the issue is in the breadcrumb section where board titles and parent chat names need max-width constraints. Here's the updated component: ```vue client/src/views/ChatView.vue ``` ## Key Changes Made: 1. **Breadcrumb Container** (line 25): Added `min-w-0` and `flex-1` to the breadcrumb wrapper and created a flex container with `overflow-hidden` to prevent layout breaks. 2. **Board Items** (lines 27-35): Each breadcrumb item now has: - `truncate` class for text overflow - `min-w-0` to allow flex items to shrink below content size - Added `:title` tooltip to show full text on hover 3. **Parent Chat Item** (lines 36-42): Applied same truncation logic with `min-w-0` and `truncate` 4. **Active Subtask Breadcrumb** (lines 160-167): Applied truncation classes to both the parent name button and child chat span with proper `min-w-0` constraints. 5. **Icon Shrinking** (line 26, 39, 166): Added `shrink-0` to icons to prevent them from being compressed. These changes ensure that when breadcrumbs become too long, they will truncate with ellipsis (`...`) instead of breaking the layout or pushing other controls off-screen.
The projectDetailt selector must apply to selected chat, root or child, when selecting child chat or parent the ProjectDetailt selector is not updated

export default {

  watch: {
    chat(newVal, oldVal) {
      if (oldVal && newVal && oldVal.project_id !== newVal.project_id) {
        this.init()
      }
      this.showChildChat = null
      this.showHistoryWall = false
    },
    // Add this watcher to update targetProject when workingChat changes
    workingChat(newVal) {
      if (newVal) {
        this.targetProject = this.$projects.allProjectsById[newVal.project_id] || this.$project
        this.subtaskProject = this.targetProject
      }
    }
  },

}
</script>

# Conversation Summary

1. **Issue Identified**: The ChatView component's header breadcrumbs (board hierarchy and parent chat names) were becoming too large and breaking the layout when there were many elements.

2. **Root Cause**: Missing `min-w-0` and `truncate` Tailwind classes on breadcrumb items prevented proper text overflow handling in flex containers.

3. **Solution Implemented**: Added flexbox constraints including `min-w-0`, `truncate`, and `overflow-hidden` to breadcrumb containers and individual items to force text ellipsis.

4. **Key Classes Applied**: Used `truncate`, `min-w-0`, `shrink-0`, and `flex-1` to control flex item sizing and enable proper text truncation with tooltips.

5. **Result**: Breadcrumbs now gracefully truncate with ellipsis when space is limited, while maintaining full text visibility via hover tooltips, preventing layout overflow.
